subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Space and shape: Position, orientation and views
source.subtopic: Position and directions (on an informal map)

show.line: Here is a map of our town. The school is next to the park. The shop is across the road!

rounds.prompt: On the map, what is next to the park?
rounds.praise: Yes! The school is next to the park.

rounds.prompt: Start at the school. Walk left. Which building do you reach?
rounds.praise: Yes! Left from the school is the shop.

rounds.prompt: Is the clinic to the left or the right of the church? Say left or right.

rounds.story: Zanele leaves the shop. She turns right and walks past the park. Where does she arrive?
rounds.praise: Yes! Past the park is the school.

rounds.prompt: Which building is between the shop and the clinic?
rounds.praise: Yes! The church is in between.

rounds.prompt: Where is the dog? Tap the picture that shows it behind the tree.

hints: Find where you start. Then follow the directions one step at a time.
Hold up your hands. Left is where your thumb and finger make an L.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! From the school, I will walk to the shop.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: I turn right from the school and I am at the shop!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! The shop is to the left of the school.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's look at the map together. School, then left, then the shop!

parent_line: Can follow left and right directions on a simple map.
